rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for events or actions occurring at the same time.

example.traditional: 我哋同時收到兩份通知。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tung4 si4 sau1 dou2 loeng5 fan6 tung1 zi1

rows.note: Use this when people or things do something together at the same time, especially in casual speech.

example.english: We simultaneously went out for dinner after work.
example.traditional: 放工後我哋一齊去食飯。
example.jyutping: fong3 gung1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 sik6 faan6

rows.traditional: 一邊 A 一邊 B
rows.jyutping: jat1 bin1 A jat1 bin1 B
rows.note: Use this when two actions are carried out concurrently by the same subject.

example.english: I simultaneously cook dinner and listen to music.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 bin1 zyu2 faan6 jat1 bin1 teng1 go1
